corrections: No contradiction of the prior bounded core-loop findings was found at the identical revision. Qualify F15: the deserializer computes expected/actual checksum metadata and returns the parsed save; rejection depends on callers. Legacy transport fields explicitly bypass mismatch comparison. A checksum is not authentication. In-flight goods are refunded into a cloned save, not settled in the live city by serialization.

A01.summary: No authored NPC conversation graph found in inspected definition/logic families. Shown: ChatPanel is player multiplayer communication, and tutorial steps are instruction records. A player chat history is not NPC dialogue or relationship AI. This scoped absence does not certify every network feature.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Keep multiplayer-like notices separate from an NPC conversation record. Owner: docs/worlds/PROGRESSION_AND_ASSEMBLY.md; src/data/dialogues.js; src/life_record.js.

A03.summary: Shown: shared TypeScript definitions/logic, React client UI, Pixi render utilities and RPC/server surfaces. Tick caches/multipliers are rebuilt; transient transport/source caches differ from saved city/meta. Author data mixes registries and closures. Server implementation is inventory-only.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Derive visible bonuses from named sources in the existing simulation. Owner: src/feature_expansion_work_plan.js; src/simulation.js.

A04.summary: Shown: JSON Map/Set replacer/reviver, city/options split, cloned transit refunds and wyhash metadata. Deserialize calculates checksum without throwing on mismatch and exempts two legacy transport shapes. MigrateSavedGame repairs shapes and uses flags for some one-time repairs. BrowserStorage wraps IndexedDB transactions. Global queues writes and selects Steam compressed file, mobile preferences or browser IndexedDB; local load returns parsed state or null on failure. Complete RPC checksum handling/corruption recovery remains partial.
yairpg: PROPOSAL: Declare transit snapshot policy and review checksum mismatch behavior at every loader. Owner: src/save_files.js; src/save_compatibility.js.
